data_access_rule: datasets are bundled sklearn reference datasets; no network fetch

split.seed_rule: integer value of first 8 hex digits of this freeze commit SHA modulo 2^31

development_protocol: fit candidates on development split; candidate choice uses validation split only; untouched test labels are read only after choice is fixed
selector: minimize validation_error + 0.002*log10(1+fit_time_ns) + 0.0001*state_kib; ties by lower state_kib then fixed candidate order
refit: selected candidate is refit on development+validation before final test evaluation; all candidates are also refit only for retrospective regret calculation after selected test score is recorded
kill_or_narrow: positive test regret does not falsify GMI broadly; it falsifies this registered selector at this real-pilot scope. zero/small regret is only portfolio-selection calibration, not K5 theory closure.
claim_ceiling: small bundled tabular/image classification pilot; same-author runner; no independent meter; not code/math/science/control transfer; not a broad known-family K5 result
